name: ease-os
description: Sixteen generic skills that set up, personalise and maintain a Claude Cowork workspace safely: setup, a 'make it mine' interview that fits the system to you (your goals, how you want replies and decisions, how you write), hygiene audit, memory routing and tiering, project scaffolding, inbox triage, correspondence logging, a sparring partner, a rubric-first quality loop, a skill builder for your own repeat tasks, a weekly goals review, session audit, a pause-and-resume checkpoint for unfinished sessions, memory consolidation, a check for switched-off skills and an orientation tour. Nothing changes without your approval, anything replaced is backed up first and nothing you wrote is ever deleted. Install, then say 'what does the EASE OS plugin do' for the tour, then 'optimise my workspace'.
